invariants.rationale: The method is about to operate on 'data', calling data.stream(), so avoiding NullPointerException is necessary.
'func' is applied to stream elements, so must be non-null for method correctness.
Parallelism is usually positive in parallel processing contexts; a non-positive value may not be meaningful.
If data is not empty, parallelism should not exceed the data size (common in data processing frameworks to avoid excessive parallelism).
It is common to constrain parallelism to the number of available processors for efficiency.
